verdict.rationale: Docs confirm developers can log in with a Claude.ai/Claude Pro or Max account (claude-code-docs-37) rather than managing API keys, and can even sign in to a Console account without creating an API key (claude-code-docs-46), which directly supports free/subscription-tier access without API key management; API key use is explicitly optional (claude-code-docs-39/40). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of a truly free (non-paid) tier limit/quota, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of the free-tier login flow experience.
